title: How the Chicago-formed company was booked for Europe; acts in the show
summary: The show's bulk came from New York but rehearsed in Chicago; Cochran booked it to Europe; Howard names the comedians and Harper and Banks.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So, the company was first in Chicago?
No, not all of it. Where?
Where did you start to work together? In New York, I mean in Chicago. In Chicago, but the bulk of the show came from New York.
Yeah, but you started to work in Chicago. That's right. And then what happened?
Well, we decided to- you ever hear of Green Wong? I forget his first name. Well, he was back in the show.
It's Chicago. And I don't know this- DeCochran, the same one that booked Florence Mills. Yeah. He booked this to Europe. So- We're off at DeCochran.
What were the different acts in that show? I joined in Foster, was one.

What were they, comedians? Yes. Real tall guy. I went to school with Foster. Bit of short guy. Was this an all-colored show? Uh-huh. And Harper and Banks. Harper was a producer. Banks was his wife. You know, that was his show name. Uh-huh. What'd they do? Well, they danced, sang, danced. I can't think of a woman's name that sang so good. Naomi Thomas. Naomi Thomas? Don't you know her?
I wasn't born there yet in those days.
No, you mean you hadn't left Turkey yet. That's what he means about being born. Oh, well, I ran that then.
And- He was still doing time in the Bospers.
I don't remember too much about those days.
